name: grain
description: Art direction for public-facing websites, dealt from a library of twelve directions; real pictures from open archives; a real-browser inspector that fails the page on the house rules.

interface.shortDescription: Art direction and a real-browser gate for coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Grain deals an art direction from a library of twelve, finds real pictures in open archives, and checks the built page in a real browser against the house rules. It also ships a redesign skill and a calm product-UI skill.
defaultPrompt: Build this landing page with a dealt direction and the grain gate.
Redesign this page: run the gate, critique the screenshots, fix the top three.
Give this product UI a calm, polished direction.
